posts.title: Completed Is Not Restored: Kyverno Fail-Open, a Velero Restore and an HTTP 200 That Meant 500
posts.description: Scale Kyverno to zero and its webhooks vanish. A Velero restore said Completed over an empty disk. A 200 carried a 500. Three statuses that reported success.

posts.title: Docker Hub Immutable Tags: The Image That Shipped Before It Was Signed
posts.description: Docker Hub immutable tags refused a per-commit tag after the version tags were already out. The image shipped, the run died, and nothing ever signed it.

posts.title: Terraform MCP server GA: the Apply Gate your auditor will ask about
posts.description: HashiCorp's Terraform MCP server is GA and IBM Bob can write production IaC. ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS separates a safe assistant from autonomous apply.
